path: 競馬予想_完全版プロンプト_v3.11.txt
rule: Read latest_prompt.json then verify e2e_validation/manifests/v3.11.json append-only SHA pins. Keep STEP1, past race reports, historical bets and v3.7 approved PDF CSS immutable. For new prereace races, run v3.11 bounded-risk B-choice purchase overlay: compare exact max-EV baseline with multi-ticket sets constrained by positive expected net profit, >=90% baseline EV with max 200-yen sacrifice, and <=2pp net-loss increase; use joint finish outcomes for union hit rate; require >=1pp union-hit gain or keep baseline. Generate selected/rejected/risk-audit as three meaningful tail chapters with unlimited dynamic pagination, no dummy pages, print every adopted/rejected ticket, rerender as needed. Seal all final_bets/proof before report; no invented odds, no post-race adjustment. The balanced search is deterministic heuristic, not globally optimal. MANDATORY EXECUTION ADDENDUM: At the start of each JRA run read docs/operations/jra_run_completion_addendum_v1.txt and verify its git blob SHA against mandatory_execution_addendum.git_blob_sha. Unless there is a concrete blocker, error, explicit time/tool limit or instruction to stop, CONTINUE WITHOUT EARLY TERMINATION through all requested races, STEP1/STEP2, prereace snapshot/proof, complete HTML/PDF (no page ceiling), validation, GitHub commit/publication and actual public HTTP/file verification. Progress reports, a completed substep, CI green status alone and user absence are never completion or stop criteria. On a real blocker, report the precise failure, completed/remaining stages, changed files and safe next action; never invent missing odds, bypass prereace freezing, modify historical originals, or claim unverified publication.

mandatory_execution_addendum.applies_to: all formal JRA runs on v3.11 without modifying prediction algorithm or prior artefacts
